'''IT-000-XZ 1594''' was an [[IT-000 interrogator droid|IT-000]] [[Interrogation droid|interrogator droid]] in service the [[First Order]]. In [[34 ABY]], that unit interrogated "[[Prisoner]] 8910542"— the [[Resistance]] [[pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]]—aboard the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Finalizer]]''. The [[torture]] bot asked about the location of the [[Map to Skywalker|map]] to [[Luke Skywalker]] 813 times, until Dameron spat at the [[droid]]. In response, the IT-000 used methods [[Method 2265|2265]], [[Method 6304|6304]], [[Method 3333|3333]], and [[Method K8-A4|K8-A4]] on the prisoner, the last one of which nearly made Dameron swallow his [[tongue]]. Eventually, [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] entered the [[Holding cell 64949|holding cell]] and shoved the droid aside to [[Mind probe (Force power)|conduct]] the interrogation himself. When Ren made his captive scream, it shattered the sensory capsules of IT-000-XZ 1594, making it incapable of further recording. The unit then made its report to translator [[RA-7-D4]], not knowing that particular [[protocol droid]] was secretly part of [[C-3PO]]'s [[spy]] [[Resistance spy droid network|network]].<ref name="Flight Log" />
